page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on x86_64 architecture. It provides 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with 2 threads via hyperthreading on an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.8 GHz. The processor includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of memory, yielding 4.0 GB per vCPU. No local storage is bundled with the instance, and it does not include hardware GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark measurements position the n2-standard-2 primarily in lower performance tiers relative to broader cloud hardware indices, reflecting its modest 2-vCPU resource envelope. In stress-ng testing, it achieves 1398.19 in single-core performance (bottom 25%) and 1837.38 in multi-core performance (bottom 10%). Geekbench results reflect similar trends, with a single-core score of 1123.0 and a multi-core score of 1333.0, including sub-scores of 1704.0 for Clang software compilation and 1369.0 for ray tracing. The PassMark CPU score is 2180.22, with an encryption sub-score of 847.96 and a database operations score of 731.04.

Memory throughput reaches 102.01 GB/sec for small cached 16 KB read blocks, dropping to 13.8 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 11.79 GB/sec for large block writes, leading to a PassMark memory score of 980.56. In application-level benchmarks, the instance delivers 1.72 million Redis SET operations per second and 1.95 GB/sec static web serving throughput. For small-scale machine learning execution using a 135M model, it processes 100.65 prompt tokens per second and generates 34.16 tokens per second.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the n2-standard-2 is technically matched for low-intensity general-purpose workloads, small web serving tasks, staging environments, lightweight microservices, and modest background utility processes that do not require local NVMe storage or substantial parallel computing capacity.

The instance supports AVX-512 instruction sets and features 33 MB of L3 cache, but includes no local storage or GPU hardware. In benchmark tests, the instance records a Geekbench single-core score of 1123.0, a multi-core score of 1333.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 2180.22. Memory bandwidth reaches 13.8 GB/sec for uncached large reads and 11.79 GB/sec for writes. The machine achieves 1.72 million Redis SET operations per second and 1.95 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. With its standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, n2-standard-2 is suited for lightweight general-purpose applications, microservices, small web servers, and development environments requiring consistent baseline resources without local disk overhead.
